name: Flowerpot (T2LT)
description: A coaxial half‑wave vertical antenna using a radiating section and a coaxial sleeve balun.
modelingNotes: The radiating element is typically a half‑wave of coax inner conductor.
The outer braid forms a sleeve balun to suppress feedline radiation.
Precise velocity factor of the coax affects element length.
Height above ground strongly influences radiation angle.
Good for portable and fixed HF/VHF operation.
